hook_b: Waiting weeks for a passport slot? *4,000* open up for Nov 21

cards.title: 🆕 What's new
cards.body: RPO Hyderabad will hold a special Passport Mela on Saturday, November 21 (The Hindu, Siasat, Telangana Today). About 4,000 appointments will be released for three services: normal passports, Tatkaal passports and Police Clearance Certificates (PCCs). Per Telangana Today, slots can be booked from November 3 at designated Passport Seva Kendras (PSKs) and Post Office PSKs (POPSKs). Which centres take part was not in the reports we read; check the Passport Seva portal when booking opens.

cards.q: How easy is getting a passport slot in Hyderabad?
Which service is NOT part of Hyderabad's Nov 21 Passport Mela?
cards.why: The drive covers normal and Tatkaal passports and PCCs only.

insight: Booking for the Nov 21 slots opens on Nov 3, at designated PSKs and POPSKs.

learn.t: PCC = Police Clearance Certificate, often needed for jobs or visas abroad.
